name: Queen Ruyi
description: Ruyi's original name is Qingying, which is opposite to the word Hongli (i.e. Qianlong), and has the beautiful meaning of "green cherry and red lychee". She is the empress of the Qing Dynasty, with a straightforward temperament, affectionate and dedicated, gentle and tough. She and Qianlong's childhood sweetheart knew each other and fell in love with each other, and they never regretted their love throughout their lives. Her persistence in love is like the fire in winter, warming people's hearts. Turn the music box and listen carefully to the endless tenderness and sweetness in the melodious melody.
